title: Electronic health record-derived machine learning model for hypoglycemia risk prediction in type 2 diabetes mellitus patients: development and validation.
summary: EHR-derived machine-learning models predicted hypoglycemia risk among type-2 diabetes patients with a validation cohort.
ai_technology: BackgroundHypoglycemia is a serious complication of diabetes. Early recognition of hypoglycemia can improve clinical prognosis, however, traditional diagnostic tools are often limited. Machine learning offers a promising approach for predicting adverse outcomes in diabetic patients.ObjectiveThis study aims to develop and validate machine learning-based models to predict the risk of hypoglycemia in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) patients.MethodsA cohort study design was employed. evidence.tested: EHR-derived machine-learning models predicted hypoglycemia risk among type-2 diabetes patients with a validation cohort.
evidence.unknown: The 831-patient EHR dataset was randomly split 70:30 within one study setting; no external validation or clinical-impact evaluation is reported.
evidence.ai_role: Four classifiers applied electronic health record variables to estimate hypoglycemia risk in adults with type 2 diabetes; the study compared them using a 70:30 internal train-validation split.
